note: Junie installs as a CLI via curl install script and also runs inside JetBrains IDEs and GitHub/GitLab CI, executing on the user's machine or CI with BYOK or JetBrains cloud credits.
PatientGPT is offered to health systems as an intelligent layer integrated into their website, portal and EHR with vendor-provided sandbox access; no self-hosted option is mentioned.
Pricing table lists Hosting: SaaS for the Community plan and 'SaaS or Self-hosted' only for the sales-led Enterprise plan.
LawDroid sells Answer, Intake and Assist as hosted assistants with a web login across web, phone and text channels; no self-host option is mentioned.
Privacy page says Pendant data is encrypted in transit and stored by Limitless using HSMs, with user download/delete controls in the app.
Limitless sold the Pendant wearable and subscriptions to consumers; after the Meta acquisition existing Pendant customers are supported for at least a year but no new sales.
CMA is described as LinkedIn's internal horizontal memory platform powering its hosted Hiring Assistant; it is not distributed for self-hosting.

Lito is delivered as an AI agent via Word/Outlook add-ins, web app and iOS with ISO 27001/SOC 2 hosted-service controls; only the separate Litera desktop comparison tool is pitched for firms that cannot move to the cloud.
Platform page describes Risk Cloud as '30+ Purpose-Built Applications, One Modern Cloud Platform'.
Security page says Luminance encrypts data with AWS KMS 'for data hosted in AWS'.
Magnitude is an open-source local inference engine that serves open models to coding agents (Pi, OpenCode, Codex) rather than a finished end-user app.
Docs say Manus operates in a complete sandbox environment, a virtual computer with internet access and persistent file system, accessed via web, desktop and mobile apps.
Mindgard is a demo-led AI red-teaming platform connected via APIs, CI/CD, Burp Suite or a single click; no self-hosted deployment is mentioned.
mymind is a sign-up service with iPhone/Android apps and browser extensions saving everything to 'one single, private place' with article backup on paid plans; no local/self-host option.
Memory is a feature of the hosted ChatGPT service, referencing saved memories and past chats across Free, Plus, Pro, Team and Enterprise accounts.
Memory is a consumer/business feature of the ChatGPT app controlled by users in Settings.
Operator is an agent that uses its own browser, typing, clicking and scrolling to perform tasks for the user; since July 2025 it is integrated into ChatGPT as agent mode.
Operator was released to ChatGPT Pro users at operator.chatgpt.com and is now ChatGPT agent mode.
The OpenMemory page's 'Set Up MCP' links to Mem0 MCP docs, which say 'Nothing runs on your machine: the server is hosted by Mem0' and memories live in the Mem0 account.

Palantir platforms are sales-led; Apollo deploys them across multi-cloud, hybrid-cloud, Private SaaS, air-gapped and edge environments as enterprise arrangements rather than public self-serve self-hosting.
Filevine security page says its products run on AWS, GCP and Azure cloud environments with AWS-hosted backups; LOIS for Word is a Word add-in to this platform.
Plaud recordings are transcribed and summarized by the Plaud app/service with data 'encrypted in transit and at rest'; no local-only processing is offered.
Help center describes account-based use via the website and official iOS/Android apps, with AI study guides saved to the user's library.
Quizlet is a study app sold to students and teachers (Quizlet Plus subscriptions).
Pricing lists unlimited synced devices and daily cloud backups behind an account; local knowledge bases are only a Pro add-on feature.
Security page says Rogo uses 'modern cloud infrastructure' with SOC 2/ISO 27001 audits; no self-hosted option is mentioned.
Security page says data between the Stream app and Sandbar's servers is TLS-encrypted and 'Cloud data is encrypted with AES-256'.
Scrintal is an account-based web app (login/get started) with macOS and Windows desktop clients; no self-host or local-only mode is mentioned.
Docs say Semgrep Multimodal 'Requires the Semgrep AppSec Platform', the hosted platform that posts LLM-generated triage and remediation to PRs.
Deployment options page describes Snyk as cloud-first: recommended multi-tenant SaaS, plus limited-availability Private Cloud on AWS.
README says the team is now building an AI coding assistant for JetBrains, available as a JetBrains Marketplace plugin.
Sweep is now an AI coding assistant plugin for JetBrains IDEs aimed at developers as end users.
Synthesis Tutor is an account-based subscription app (log in / try it free) on iPad, Android and the web; no offline/self-host option.
Install guide says to install and activate the Tabnine plugin in your IDE (VS Code, JetBrains, etc.), backed by Tabnine SaaS or a private installation.
Tana Outliner is sign-up based with workspace storage quotas and AI credits per plan, plus desktop/mobile clients; no self-host option.
ima runs as a web app with a downloadable desktop version and asks users to log in to sync conversation history (登录以同步历史会话).
LegalWorks page lists 'Flexible deployment options: public cloud, private cloud, and on-premises', all through a demo-led enterprise sale with SaaS as the default.
Trace is a beta SaaS orchestration layer connecting Slack, HubSpot and Google Drive, with access by contacting the team; no self-host option is mentioned.
Holly AI signals are part of a Trade Ideas subscription delivered through its Web Dashboard and the downloadable TI Pro client.
Homepage says TrustCloud is ServiceNow-native, delivered as a continuous-monitoring service; no self-hosted option.
AI Studio runs on Vonage's communications APIs, either 'fully managed deployment by AI experts' or built in its low-code flow builder; no self-host option.
